channel.description: This week's upcoming Gov-Hub meetings and community events across the Telluride region (Town of Telluride, Mountain Village, San Miguel County, the Sheridan Opera House, The Alibi, Wilkinson Library, KOTO, telluride.com, and more).

item.title: 📅 The Week Ahead — Nov 20–26
item.description: The School Board meets Friday morning for a special session that includes a first reading of Policy JJJ — a revised extracurricular eligibility policy that incorporates Colorado's statutory definitions of male and female for athletic team participation, so that one is worth watching closely. Meanwhile, the gondola re-opens for winter on Friday, the People's March is Saturday, Alpine Chapel's free community Friendsgiving is Sunday, and the week closes out with Turkey Trots and Thanksgiving gatherings on Thursday.

item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Telluride Board of Education Special Meeting — 2026-11-20
item.description:
Telluride School District • 2026-11-20
A special meeting with a lot packed into one Friday morning. The board takes up a first reading of Policy JJJ — a revised extracurricular eligibility policy that incorporates Colorado's statutory definitions of male and female for athletic team participation, along with updated rules for homeschooled, charter, and nonpublic-school students seeking to participate in district activities. Then the meeting moves into executive session on two fronts: selecting a superintendent search consultant (with reference-check materials protected under CORA's mandatory nondisclosure provisions), and a personnel matter involving Superintendent John Pandolfo. Coming out of executive session, the board votes on approving the search consultant and any investigative action tied to the Pandolfo matter. The board also conducts a self-assessment under GP-4-E.
⚡ Why it matters: Board takes first reading of gender-eligibility policy for school athletics.

Come learn all about the winter program and how to get involved! For more information, call 970-728-2443 or email volunteer@ tellurideadaptivesports.org . Virtual link available upon request. You can also visit the website at tellurideadaptivesports.org .

item.title: [Tue, Nov 24] Around The World: America’s Pumpkin Beer & Chocolate Pretzels
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Wine Mine, Telluride Owner and Brewmaster, TJ is taking us on a journey to early America to discover how a humble native gourd became our continent’s most iconic seasonal tradition. Long before pumpkin spice became a modern phenomenon, early American colonists relied on native pumpkins to survive winter and celebrate the harvest holidays. Join us for a curated tasting event exploring the rich history of American pumpkin brewing paired with traditional European-style chocolate pretzels. Grab your tasting passport, explore the global trade routes that brought us holiday spices, and toast to the historic flavors of the American harvest season! (Ages 21+ only).
